s: Dine chute hatztzitzit, ubo l"h seipim: mitzvat tzitzit, bizman shehaya tekelet matzuy — haya mitzvatah sheyyiqqach b' chutin tzebuin [betzeba] hanniqra tekelet, ub' chutin sheenan tzebuin hanniqraim chute laban, mippene sheen anu metzuvvim letzoban mimmela nisharim belabnutam. Veakshav sheen lanu tekelet — tzarik liqqach b' chute laban bimqom b' chute tekelet, mippene sheen tzitzit pachot mid' chutin, shenneemar: "gedilim taaseh lak", veen gadil pachot mib' chutin sheggodelan zeh al gab zeh, ukeshehu omer "gedilim" hare kan arba. Veim hosip apillu chut echad al had' chutin — hare abar al "bal tosip", velaken otah hatztzitzit shehosip bah hachut hi pesula, ad sheyyasir chut echad mimmenna (ayyen siman yod):

Chute hatztzitzit tzerikin shezira, shenneemar: "petil tekelet", sheyyihyeh tavuy veshazur keen petila, umah tekelet tavuy veshazur — ap laban ken, shehare huqqeshu zeh lazeh, shenneemar: "gedilim taaseh vego'":

Utzerikim sheyyihyu tevuyin ushezurin leshem tzitzit davqa, dehaynu sheyyomar bitchillat hatteviyya vehashshezira shehu oseh ken leshem tzitzit, o sheyyomar laishsha: tevi li tzitzit letallit, shenneemar: "taaseh lak" — leshem chobateka. Veim lo hayu tevuyin lishman, o shello hayu shezurin lishman — pesulin. Veyesh baale nepesh shemmachamirin al atzman apillu benipputz hatztzemer, abal en nohagin ken:

Tavan nokri o sheshshazar, apillu yisrael omed al gabbayv veomer lo sheyyaaseh leshem tzitzit — pesulin, denokri adaatteh denapsheh qaabid veeno choshesh ledibre hayyisrael, ella im ken mesayyea hayyisrael meat. Abal im tavan o shezaran cheresh shoteh veqatan vegadol omed al gabbayv veomer lahem sheyyaasu leshem tzitzit — kasher:

Arbaa chute hatztzitzit tzarik littenam lattallit ulekoplam, kede sheyyihyu shemona chutin, shenneemar: "petil tekelet", sheyyihyeh kapul keen petila. Uleachar shekkepalan tzarik sheyyihyeh bekol chut mehach' chutin orek y"b gudalin, umodedin bammaqom harachab shebbaggudal:
Shiur haggudal shel adam benoni hu kerochab z' seorot keshemmunnachot zo betzad zo bedochaq, vehen keorek b' seorot berevach:

Ellu hashshenem asar gudalin modedin leachar sheasa kol hakkerikot vehaqqesharim, umatchilin limdod otan missepat hakkanap, abal kol mah shemmunnach al hakkanap en limdod biklal hacheshbon. Velaken tzarik sheyyihyeh orek kol chut mehaarbaa chutin sheloshim gudalin, diksheyyikpelem yihyeh kol chut mehashshemona chutin chamishsha asar gudalin: shene gudalin minneqeb hattallit shebbo tochabin hatztzitzit ad sepat hakkanap, dehaynu shiur qesher agudal sheyyitbaer leqamman besiman zeh, vegudal echad lehaqqesharim, ushenem asar gudalin yihyu teluyin leheksher hatztzitzit:

Echad mehachutin yihyeh yoter arok, kede sheyyikrok bo et haggadil kemo sheyyitbaer besiman zeh leqamman. Veim en lo chut echad arok kol kak sheyyukal likrok bo kol hakkerikot — yakol likrok qetzat kerikot bechut zeh uqetzat kerikot bechut acher, ki ken bizman shehaya tekelet matzuy hayu korekin qetzat kerikot bitkelet uqetzatam bechute hallaban:
Im rotzeh laasot hatztzitzit arukkin yoter mi"b gudalin — rashshay, veyakol lehaarikam kemo sheyyirtzeh. Vetob laasot ken, kede sheapillu im yippasequ yishshaer bahem y"b gudalin:

Kebar amarnu besiman t shehatztzitzit tzerikin lihyot mimmin hakkanap davqa, velaken en osin hatztzitzit min hatztzemer hanneechaz baqqotzim keshehatztzon robetzim benehem, velo min hannimin hannitlashin min hatztzon, velo min shiyyure sheti shehaoreg meshayyer besop habbeged. Veim asa mehen tzitzit — hare hem pesulim, lepi sheen minim hallalu reuyim laasot mehem beged, shehen pesolet hatztzemer veen habbeged naaset mikkemotan, vehattora omra "hakkanap" — min kanap, kemo shennitbaer besiman t. Vehu haddin kol mine tzemer haggeruin sheen beged naaset mehen — pesulin letzitzit mittaam haamur:

Gazal chutin shennitvu leshem tzitzit vehalak haggazlan veasa mehem tzitzit — hare hem pesulin, shenneemar: "veasu lahem" — mishshellahem, perat legazel. Veim makar haggazlan et hatztzitzit leacher , im kebar nityaashu habbealim mehem — hare hem kesherim, mippene sheqqana otan halloqeach beyeush bealim veshinnuy reshut mehaggazlan lalloqeach, kemo shekkatub bechoshen mishpat siman shasa:

Gazal tzemer shello nitva utevaan haggazlan leshem tzitzit, im adayin lo nityaashu habbealim mimmennu — hare hem pesulim letzitzit, mippene shehem adayin gazel veenam shel gazlan kelal, shehare lo qana otan beshinnuy zeh sheasaan chutin, mippene shehu shinnuy hachozer libriyyato, shehare hachutin epshar lachazor velaasot otan tzemer. Abal im kebar nityaashu habbealim mimmennu, o apillu im lo nityaashu adayin ella shehaggazlan asa betzemer zeh shinnuy gamur sheen chozer libriyyato , kegon shellibben et hatztzemer begoprit, veal derek shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman shas ayyen sham, kevan shehaggazlan qana et hatztzemer legamre, deha apillu im hatztzemer hu beayin en tzarik lehachazir lehannigzal ella deme hatztzemer, im ken hare hi keshello mammash lekol dabar, velaken hatztzitzit sheasa mimmennu hare hem kesherim. Abal mikkol maqom lo yebarek alehem, deen zeh mebarek ella menaetz, kevan sheal yede gezela ba hatztzitzit leyado:

Hammishtachaveh libhema — tzamrah pasul letzitzit. Ap-al-pi sheen baale chayyim shenneebdu asurim lehedyot, vekol hamchubbar lo hare hu kamohu, veim ken hatztzemer hazzeh muttar lehedyot, mikkol maqom lemitzva asur mishshum demaus hu legaboah, shehare baale chayyim shenneebdu asurin legaboah legabbe hammizbeach, veim ken hu haddin latztzemer sheal gabbehen. Veap al pi diksheoseh mimmennu tzitzit hu mishtanneh mikkemot shehaya, shehare miqqodem haya tzemer veakshav naasu chutin, mikkol maqom adayin marehu alayv venikkar shehu tzemer. Abal hammishtachaveh lepishtan natua — muttar laasot mimmennu tzitzit, shehare mechubbar shenneebad muttar bahanaa, veap legaboah eno maus kelal kevan shennishtanna mikkemot shehaya beshaa shenneebad, shehare miqqodem haya keetz bealma, veakshav sheasa mimmennu chutin hare mareh harishon chalap vehalak lo mimmennu legamre:

Kesheoseh hanneqeb shettocheb bo hatztzitzit — lo yaasennu lemala mishshelosha gudalin missepat habbeged, mippene shenneemar: "al hakkanap", ulemala mishshelosha en zeh kanap ella beged. Veim asa hanneqeb lemala mishshelosha gudalin, ap al pi (shekkesheosheh) [shekkesheqqosher] hatztzitzit babbeged oseh hachutin qetzarim al hakkanap kede lehaqmit hakkenapot umitkappel ad shebba hanneqeb lematta mishshelosha gudalin — apillu hake pasul:

Veim asa hanneqeb lemala mishshelosha gudalin, veachar shehetil hatztzitzit banneqeb chatak banneqeb kede sheyyittalu hatztzitzit lematta mishshelosha gudalin — pasul, mishshum shenneemar: "gedilim taaseh vego'" — velo min heasuy kebar bipsul, kemo shennitbaer besiman y:

Velo yaaseh hanneqeb samuk lispat habbeged, shenneemar: "al hakkanap", veim haya samuk meod lispat habbeged — haya tachat hakkanap. Velaken tzarik leharchiq hanneqeb missepat habbeged keshiur sheyyesh min qesher agudal ad sop hatztzipporen, dehaynu leerek shene gudalin. Veim achar kak kesheqqosher hatztzitzit asa cheleq hachutin sheal hakkanap qetzarim venitkappelu hakkenapot ad shebba hanneqeb lematta mishshiur shennitbaer — apillu hake kasher:

Shiur shelosha gudalin ellu sheamarnu, veken shiur melo qesher agudal shetztzarik leharchiq — modedin otan beyosher missepat orek habbeged, veken missepat rochab habbeged, abal lo yimdod otam baalakson min haqqeren zaviyyot shel kenap habbeged:

Shiur melo qesher agudal sheamarnu shetztzarik leharchiq hanneqeb missepat habbeged — en tzarik lizzaher bazeh ella bishat hatalat hatztzitzit babbeged, abal im leachar shehetil hatztzitzit babbeged nittequ michute hashsheti o haereb venitracheb hanneqeb veyaredu hatztzitzit lematta mimmelo qesher agudal — kasher. Veken im leachar hatalat tzitzit babbeged nistar habbeged millematta bispato ad shennipchat min hassapa ad hakkanap mishshiur melo qesher agudal — kasher. Shello hiqpida tora al zeh shello tehe hatztzitzit tachat hakkanap ella bishat asiyya, shenneemar: "veasu lahem tzitzit al kanpe vego'". Umikkol maqom lekattechilla tob laasot imra sebib hanneqeb shettocheb bo hatztzitzit, kede shello yinnatequ hachutin shel beged mibbipnim sebib hanneqeb, veyipchat mishshiur melo qesher agudal missepat habbeged, veyisberu haolam shehaya ken qodem hatalat hatztzitzit. Veken yaaseh imra bispat habbeged, kede shello yipchat mishshiur qesher agudal missepato ad hanneqeb:

Im yesh gadil (sheqqorin liisat) bispat habbeged sheggodelin sham, kede sheyyihyeh chazaq, ben shehaggadil hu bispat rochab habbeged ben shehu bispat orek habbeged — lo yatil et hatztzitzit sham baggadil, ap al pi shehu [marchiq] melo qesher agudal missepat hakkanap, kegon shehaggadil hu rachab, ap al pi ken en metilin bo tzitzit, mishshum shenneemar "al kanpe bigdehem", vehaggadil eno nechshab iqqar min habbeged, ella hu tapel umeshammesh labbeged:

Keshemmetilin tzitzit babbeged atzmo — en tzarik leharchiq missepat habbeged melo qesher agudal chutz min haggadil, ella gam haggadil nechshab biklal hashshiur. Veken leinyan harchaqat shelosha gudalin sheamarnu — nechshab gam ken haggadil biklal habbeged. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shello yihyeh hanneqeb lemala mishshelosha gudalin min sepat haggadil hachitzona:

Ap al pi shehaggadil nechshab biklal habbeged leinyan shiur melo qesher agudal, mikkol maqom lekattechilla tob limdod melo qesher agudal belo haggadil veyihyeh hanneqeb tok shelosha haggudalin im haggadil kemo shennitbaer, veim haggadil rachab harbeh — yachtok miqtzato:

Im bispat habbeged boletin chute sheti belo ereb o ereb belo sheti — yesh lehistappeq im ellu hachutin nechshabin biklal habbeged o lav, kevan sheenan kearig gamur, laken tzarik lizzaher shello yihyeh hanneqeb lemala mishshelosha gudalin missepat hachutin hallalu, shemma hen nechshabin biklal habbeged. Veim meshek hachutin hu rachab harbeh — yachtok qetzato. Vegam yizzaher limdod melo qesher agudal lebad meellu hachutin, shemma enam nechshabim biklal habbeged:

Muttar liqqach chut echad arok vekopelo learbaa vetochabah bakkanap vekopelam vahare hem shemona, veachar-kak poseq rashe hachutin venaasim shemona chutin. Veim shakach velo pasaq rashe hachutin ad shekkarak apillu chulya achat veachar shekkarak hachulya qashar apillu qesher echad — pasul, kevan demin hattora day bechulya achat veqesher echad, shehare neemar setam "gedilim taaseh" velo (nitparet) [nitparesh] bakkatub minnayin haggedilim, im ken kebar naasu hatztzitzit bipsul, shehare keshekkarak hachulya veqashar haqqesher — lo hayu arbaa chutin shelemim ella chut echad kapul lishmona, velaken apillu im yipsoq achar-kak et rashe hachutin — en moil kelum, kevan sheggup hatztzitzit kebar naasu bipsul, vehattora omra "taaseh", velo min heasuy kebar bipsul. Abal im pasaq rashe hachutin tekep achar shekkarak chulya achat qodem sheqqashar apillu qesher echad achar hachulya, vekol shekken im pasaq otam tekep achar haqqesher harishon qodem shehitchil likrok et hachulya — kasher, kevan shello naasu adayin kol heksher tzitzit hakketuba battora bipsul qodem sheppasaq rashe hachutin — en leposlan mishshum "taaseh velo min heasuy kebar bipsul". Umikkol maqom lekattechilla tob lipsoq rashe hachutin qodem sheyyitchob et hatztzitzit banneqeb, bikde shello yaaseh shum asiyya mehatztzitzit bipsul:
Tob lizzaher shello lachtok hatztzitzit besakkin, al derek shenneemar: "lo tanip alehem barzel vego'", ella yinshekem beshinnayv:

Katub battora "gedilim taaseh lak", yakol yaasennu kullo gedil — talmud lomar "veasu lahem tzitzit", vetzitzit hem chutin nipradin kemo shennitbaer besiman ch, ha ketzad? Sheyyehe gedil yotze mehakkanap vetzitzit yotze mehaggedil. Veen laggedil shiur min hattora, laken ben shekkarak rob orek hatztzitzit ben shello karak ella chulya achat — kasher, ubilbad sheyyaaseh besop hakkerika qesher, mishshum dehakkerika enah mitqayyemet belo qesher leachareha, venimtza sheen kan gedil:
Im karak kol hatztzitzit velo heniach apillu mashshehu anap yotze — pasul, shehare neemar: "tzitzit":

Bizman shehaya tekelet tiqqenu chakamim shello lipchot millikrok sheba chulyot keneged shiba reqiim, shehattekelet doma laraqia. Veken tiqqenu laasot qesher besop kol chulya vechulya, sheyyehe hekker ben chulya lechulya. Veakshav sheen lanu tekelet — en anu tzerikin ledaqdeq beminyan hachulyot velo beminyan haqqesharim shebben hachulyot. Umikkol maqom hamminhag pashut bekol yisrael mishshanim qadmoniyyot laasot chamishsha qesharim, mishshum shenneemar: "ureitem oto uzekartem et kol mitzvot Hashem", vekol hammitzvot hem try"g, ve"tzitzit" begimatriyya t"r vech' chutin vh' qesharim oleh try"g:

Nahagu laasot arbaa avirim ben hachamishsha qesharim velikrok bekol avir qetzat kerikot, ketzad? Loqeach arbaa chutin mitztzad echad shel hakkanap vearbaa mitztzad hashsheni veqosheram zeh al [gabbe] zeh shene peamim, ki haechad lo yitqayyem veeno chashub qesher kelal, veachar-kak yikrok bachut haarok sebib hashshiba chutin qetzat kerikot, vechozer veqosher shene peamim zeh al gabbe zeh, vechozer vekorek, veken yaaseh ad sheyyashlim chamishsha qesharim kepulim vearbaa avirim benetayim meleim kerikot. Veen shiur leminyan hakkerikot shebbekol avir, ella yaaseh kemo sheyyirtzeh:

Noy tzitzit sheyyihyeh shelish orek hachutin, dehaynu arbaa gudalin gedil ushene shelishin anap. Vaapillu heerik hatztzitzit yoter mishshenem asar gudalin — tzarik sheyyihyeh shelish haorek gedil. Vehaqqesharim vehakkerikot beyachad hem niqraim gedil bekol maqom, uben hakkol lo yihyeh ella shelish orek hachutin dehaynu arbaa gudalin. Uberaaya mehemena katub sheyyihyeh ben qesher leqesher kimlo rochab agudal lebad mehaqqesharim:

Nohagim likrok baavir harishon sheba kerikot ubashsheni shemoneh ubashshelishi achat esreh ubarebii shelosh esreh kerikot, sheolim kullam lemispar sheloshim vatesha, keminyan "hvy"h echad". Ulepi shennoy hu latztzitzit sheyyihyeh orek kol chulyot beshaveh, laken baavir harishon shehakkerikot hem muatim — yarchiqem zo mizzo, ubaavir hashsheni — yeqorbem zo lezo meat, ubashshelishi — yeqorbem yoter, ubarebii — yoter, ad sheyyihyeh midda achat lekullam:

Yesh nohagin likrok hakkerikot shebbekol avir chulyot chulyot, dehaynu leachar shekkarak shalosh kerikot harishonot — yarchiq meat veyachazor veyikrok shalosh peamim beoto avir atzmo, veachar-kak yikrok achat meavir harishon vitzarep lezeh shettayim meavir hashsheni, veyarchiq meat veyikrok od shalosh peamim, veken yaaseh ad kelot hashsheloshim vetesha kerikot bishlosh esreh chulyot qetannot. Veken hayu osin bazzeman shehaya tekelet:

Kol hashshiurim shebbearnu beminyan hachulyot o hakkerikot o haqqesharim enan ella lekattechilla, abal bediabad shekkebar gamar asiyyat hatztzitzit, o bishat haddechaq, kegon beereb shabbat im chasheka sheen lo penay — heemidu dibrehem al din tora, veday bechulya achat ubeqesher echad, veyakol lebarek alehem:

Yesh nohagin liqshor besop kol chut mehashshemona chutin qesher echad, shello yitparequ mishsheziratan. Veyesh sheenan nohagin ken, mippene sheenam rotzim lehosip al chamishsha qesharim mittaam shennitbaer lemala, ubiprat im hachutin shezurin yapeh delo shakiach kelal sheyyitparequ:

Keshettoleh hatztzitzit babbeged — tzarik ledaqdeq sheyyitleh beinyan sheyyihyeh haggedil hattaluy nogea umakkeh biknap habbeged, velo yihyeh taluy kelappe qarqa, shenneemar: "al kanpe bigdehem", velaken shette tzitzit hattachtonot yihyu teluyim leorek habbeged, diksheyyaatop bo veyihyeh orek hattallit sebib rochab gupo — yihyu hatztzitzit nogeim umakkim al haqqeren abal im hayeta teliyyat haggedil al rochab habbeged, im ken kesheyyaatop et qomato merosho ad raglayv berochab habbeged — yihyeh haggedil taluy kelappe haqqarqa, velo yihyeh toleh venogea umakkeh al hakkanap. Ubishte tzitzit haelyonim — peamim tzarik sheyyihyeh haggedil taluy leorek habbeged velipamim lerochbo, vehakkol lepi atipato, raq yizzaher shello yihyeh haggedil taluy kelappe haqqarqa, ella nogea umakkeh al haqqeren:

Yesh omerim sheen laasot hatztzitzit babbeged kemo sheanu osim, ella yaaseh shene neqabim babbeged veyatil hatztzitzit banneqeb haechad veyotziem derek neqeb hashsheni. Veen halaka ke"yesh omerim" ellu, vehabba lehachamir al atzmo velaasot kedibrehem — lo yaaseh ken ella betallit qatan, kede shello yihyeh nireh lakkol umitchazze keyohara:
